propositions: A bare git repository created with `git init --bare` and pushed into races concurrent `git maintenance run --detach` spawned by receive-pack's auto-maintenance hook, which outlives the push and repacks loose objects mid-copytree, causing random fanout directories under objects/ to vanish
Filtering `objects/maintenance.lock` from copytree is insufficient because the repack process deletes entire fanout directories like `objects/2c/` and `objects/2d/`, not just lockfiles

Pinning `receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, and `maintenance.autoDetach=false` on fixture bare remotes before any push eliminates background processes and removes the race structurally rather than narrowing the window

The test must guard against regression by asserting under GIT_TRACE2_EVENT that no `git maintenance run` child spawned by the push carries `--detach`, with a positive control verifying the trace recorded the push's receive-pack
The existing test's repoint assertion remains the earliest tripwire and still proves the copy operation correctly re-points a cloned store at its own sibling origin
